estimate.no_interval: one replication: the figures are point estimates with no interval, so the randomness of the workload is not covered

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 8192: vLLM main's default (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes and _split_cudagraph_capture_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2465-2870 at 0fda86a), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes: the SM100 split defaults: a prefill token grid up to 8192 and a decode request grid up to max_num_seqs (CudaPlatformBase.get_cudagraph_capture_defaults, vllm/platforms/cuda.py:640-652); a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b200, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m2.5//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
